<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  id="Definitions_Sales"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Customer approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Customer inquiry to confirmed order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Sales">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddressConcerns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CustomerInterest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesRepresentative" name="Sales representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CustomerApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns or questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerInterest" name="Customer interested?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerApproval" name="Receive customer approval">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Approval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in the system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inquiry_Collect" sourceRef="Start_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Address" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Address_Interest" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interest_Yes" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer is interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interest_No" name="Not interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest" targetRef="End_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer is not interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guide_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_Approval" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_CustomerApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Place" sourceRef="Event_CustomerApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_Record" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_End" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Sales">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Sales" name="Sales" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Customer approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CustomerApproval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
